comments.text: Imagine pitching your tent on a stranger's land in Norway… and it's completely legal. ⛺ That's only one of the surprises in this life in Norway documentary. There are roads that run straight into the sea, a "Doomsday Vault" built deep inside an Arctic mountain, and a tiny town where the famous rule about dying isn't quite what the internet says. 👀👇 So tell us honestly: ⛺ Camp beside a quiet mountain lake, or ⛴ sail through the fjords on a ferry? Drop your answer in the comments, and subscribe so you don't miss our next country! 🌍 #LifeInNorway #NorwayDocumentary #Norway
